changes.comment: Add `nullable` to the JsonSchema LLM-tool subset: every factory accepts `nullable: true`, which widens `Static<S>` to `T | null`, accepts `null`, and emits the draft-07 union `type: [<type>, 'null']` (a nullable enum also carries `null` in its `enum` list). This is the spelling OpenAI strict structured output accepts for an absent-able field, where `optional(...)` is unsendable because every property must be in `required`. `fromJson` learns the same union shape so an emitted schema survives the round trip through the proxy path; every other union `type` is still refused.
